materials_exhausted.note: OA package contains NXML/PDF/figures; supplementary_original links resolve to HTML landing/support pages and no structured assay supplement tables were locally present.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered Table 1 MIC/MBC rows, Table 2 condition-specific MIC rows, prose-supported biofilm/safety/in vivo values, and reconciled DBAASP/APD6 rows while preserving database conflicts as cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows that directly match Table 1/Table 2/prose values are source_verified; MBIC label, figure-only hemolysis at 32 ug/mL, cytotoxicity-complement rows, and APD6 generalized text remain source_conflict with explicit context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 54 source-located activity/toxicity/in vivo records were recovered from XML tables and PDF/XML prose with units and target species/strain where available.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are source-specific and assay-classified; direct mechanism is limited to membrane/permeability/PMF/metabolism assays, while biofilm remains phenotypic activity.

caution_findings.impact: MBIC labels are retained as database annotations while primary activity rows use source-supported biofilm-formation inhibition concentration.
The 32 ug/mL 50% hemolysis database value is not promoted to a primary-source toxicity row because local XML/PDF text did not expose that exact value.
Primary text reports cell survival; database reports complementary cytotoxicity percentages.
APD6 entry text is retained as source_conflict where units/structure phrasing diverge from the article.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Local supplementary_original assets are HTML landing/support pages; OA package has article XML/PDF/figures and no true assay supplement spreadsheet.
